rows.value_as_printed: Freeze drying system (collector, drying chamber with shelves and ports); no grinding/milling function
rows.quote: The CSD Facility has a Labconco FreeZone 6 Liter -50°C freeze drying system. The drying chamber has three 10-inch diameter adjustable shelves and 6 ports. Freeze drying is the first step in preparation for many analytical procedures of soft sediment lithologies.
rows.document_title: CSD Facility, Subsample Preparation and Analysis (University of Minnesota)
rows.reasoning: The facility's own description states what this installed machine is: a freeze drying system made of a collector and a shelved drying chamber with flask ports. The Labconco FreeZone specification (cached research/v5/cache/691692592182d153.txt) lists every standard feature and every option (refrigeration, purge valve, PTFE coating, shell freezer, mini vacuum drying chamber, plugs) and none is a mill or grinding jar. A freeze dryer removes water by sublimation; it does not comminute samples. Mechanical cryogenic milling therefore does not exist on this machine.

rows.value_as_printed: No grinding jar / vibration drive on a freeze dryer
rows.quote: Options include: Single 3/4 hp, 1 hp or 1-1/2 hp HCFC/CFC-free refrigeration system to cool collector to -50° C (-58° F) ... Purge valve ... PTFE-coated collector coil and chamber for corrosive compounds ... Built-in shell freezer ... Built-in stainless steel mini vacuum drying chamber
rows.document_title: Labconco FreeZone 6, 12 & 18 Liter Console Freeze Dryers specifications (Labconco catalog pp. 18-19, hosted by Thermo Fisher)
rows.reasoning: The milling frequency is the vibration frequency of a grinding jar. The manufacturer's complete option list and the facility description (a freeze drying system with a shelved drying chamber and ports) show no milling drive exists on this machine, so the function itself is absent; the only frequencies in the document are 50/60 Hz mains supply, which the vocabulary excludes. Recorded as not_available rather than a number.

rows.value_as_printed: No grinding jar on a freeze dryer
rows.quote: All models feature: Upright stainless steel collector coil capable of holding 6, 12 or 18 liters of ice before defrosting.
rows.document_title: Labconco FreeZone 6, 12 & 18 Liter Console Freeze Dryers specifications (Labconco catalog pp. 18-19, hosted by Thermo Fisher)
rows.reasoning: The '6 L' in the model name is the ice capacity of the collector coil, not a grinding jar. The manufacturer's feature and option lists, together with the CSD description of the installed freeze drying system, contain no grinding jar or mill, so the function does not exist on this machine. The 6 L collector volume must not be read as a jar volume.

The record holds only the collector rating (-50 C), which is not a sample temperature. The CSD page says the drying chamber has three 10-inch adjustable shelves and 6 ports but does not say whether the shelves are plain or Labconco heated product shelves. Distributor listings (Fisher Scientific, VWR, Marshall Scientific) for Labconco Heated Product Shelf Chambers give a shelf set range of -20 C to +60 C (post-2017; ambient to +40 C for 2016 and earlier), while a plain clear chamber has no shelf temperature control at all. Because the installed chamber type is not documented, neither a value nor an absence can be stated. Searched: the CSD facility page, the Labconco console brochure, WebSearch for Labconco drying chamber / heated product shelf specifications and for CSD facility freeze-dryer details (Tavily search was unavailable: plan usage limit).

Labconco FreeZone lids and drying chambers are clear acrylic (the console brochure lists a 'Clear acrylic chamber lid' and a front panel 'with viewing window'), so visual sight of samples may exist, but the CSD page does not identify the installed chamber model or describe any optical port, and nothing documents optical/microscope access to a sample for measurement. Neither a positive value nor a positively established absence could be sourced (claiming absence would contradict the transparent chamber). Searched the CSD page, the Labconco console brochure and distributor chamber listings.

No source gives a sample or shelf temperature stability for this installed system. Whether it even has controlled (heated) shelves is undocumented (see temperature.range); the CSD page and the Labconco console brochure give only collector temperature and capacity. Searched the CSD page, the Labconco brochure, and distributor listings for heated product shelf chambers (none states a stability figure).

If the installed drying chamber were a Labconco Heated Product Shelf Chamber, Lyo-Works can set shelf temperatures, which might count as programmable temperature steps; if it is a plain chamber, there is no temperature program. The CSD page does not say which chamber is installed, so absence cannot be positively established and no value can be sourced. Searched the CSD page, the Labconco console brochure and distributor heated-shelf listings.

rows.value_as_printed: Freeze drying system for sediment sample preparation; no electrodes or impedance measurement chain
rows.quote: The CSD Facility has a Labconco FreeZone 6 Liter -50°C freeze drying system. The drying chamber has three 10-inch diameter adjustable shelves and 6 ports. Freeze drying is the first step in preparation for many analytical procedures of soft sediment lithologies.
rows.document_title: CSD Facility, Subsample Preparation and Analysis (University of Minnesota)
rows.reasoning: The facility describes this machine as a sample-preparation freeze drying system (a preparation step before other analyses), not a measurement instrument. The Labconco specification's full feature list (collector, Lyo-Works display of collector temperature and vacuum, moisture sensor, vacuum valves) and option list contain no sample electrodes or complex-resistivity/impedance measurement chain. The installed machine therefore does not provide this module.
